- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In 1949, Einstein wrote "Why Socialism?" advocating for a socialist economic system prioritizing welfare over profit and criticizing capitalism's inequalities.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In the 1940s and 1950s, Einstein was involved in civil rights activism, campaigning against segregation and racism in the U.S.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] General relativity was influenced by Einstein's imagination regarding the curvature of space, explaining gravity and light bending around massive objects.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In 1905, Einstein published a paper on Brownian motion, explaining it through creative thinking about particle movement in a liquid.
